gold: Bullous lichen planus of the nails

selector.why: The presence of lichenoid plaques, hyperkeratosis, hypergranulosis, acanthosis, basal cell degeneration, and dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate in the papillary dermis, along with the absence of any evidence against it, decided the diagnosis.
